docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Cunningham’s edition of the rock and pillar edicts of Aśoka, with the texts in Brāhmī and Kharoṣṭhī, English translations and plates (Calcutta, 1877). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Corpus Inscriptionum Indicarum Volume I, Inscriptions Of Asoka · Cunningham, Alexander · 1877, 224 scanned pages. Published 1877; Alexander Cunningham died 1893; the inscriptions are of the third century BC; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
